ImageDescription.value: Bronze Standing Statue of Confucius at East Lake Park, in Shenzhen, Guangdong, China. The Bronze Standing Statue of Confucius at Donghu Park, Shenzhen was unveiled on October 11, 2009, the 2560th anniversary of Confucius' birth. It was fully funded and donated by Samwo International Group, and it is the first large outdoor statue of Confucius erected in a public urban park in Shenzhen. Cast entirely in bronze, the full-body statue stands nearly 6-metre (20 ft) tall. Confucius is depicted in traditional wide-sleeved Confucian robes with hands folded respectfully before his chest, bearing a gentle and solemn facial expression with detailed carved robe folds. The statue rests on a red granite plinth engraved with golden characters "Confucius" and the inscription "Erected with reverence at Donghu Park, Shenzhen". In front of the plinth sits an antique bronze censer carved with ancient seal script "The Eternal Teacher of All Ages" and traditional bronze ritual patterns, reserved for citizens' sacrificial offerings. Note: The carved calligraphy inscriptions on the granite plinth and bronze censer are not in the public domain.
